scope_statement: Bounded audit of the documented full developer MCP, public caller-delegated RLM, durable runtime, DB-backed brokers, programmable IPython worker, host profiles and operation skills. This register is implementation input, not a claim that no other defect exists.

defects.title: DB-backed artifact broker violates SQLite thread ownership
defects.native_trigger: Create a programmable IPython workspace through the installed MCP and call aar_artifact() in a cell.
defects.observed_result: WORKSPACE_EXECUTION_FAILED with sqlite3.ProgrammingError stating that the connection was created in a different thread.

evidence.summary: Persistent cell execution passed; cell artifact publication failed certain at the DB-backed sink.
Same-thread FakeArtifactBroker.put passed; a ThreadPoolExecutor call on the same DB-backed instance reproduced the same SQLite signature.
DB connection is created with default thread affinity and no serialization lock.

defects.violated_invariant: A documented native artifact operation must work through the attached supervisor regardless of the frontend/dispatcher thread that invokes it.
defects.repair_boundary: Introduce a thread-safe DB-backed artifact repository with explicit close ownership; do not apply check_same_thread=False without serialized access and race tests.

defects.title: DB-backed subagent broker has the same cross-thread defect family
defects.native_trigger: Invoke DB-backed FakeSubagentBroker.submit from a dispatcher/worker thread, as an integrated RLM would do.
defects.observed_result: Same-thread submit passed; cross-thread submit raised the same sqlite3.ProgrammingError.

evidence.summary: Cross-thread submit reproduced on exact v0.4.0a6.
Subagent broker repeats the DB connection and no-lock pattern.

defects.violated_invariant: Recursive subagent work must remain usable from the runtime thread that owns the RLM attempt.
defects.repair_boundary: Use a real injected subagent adapter for product work and a thread-safe SQLite reference repository for conformance/history.

defects.title: aar_artifact logical filename is discarded
defects.native_trigger: Call aar_artifact('result.txt', ...) and inspect the returned workspace event and resolvable reference.
defects.observed_result: The worker emits name, but the backend passes only content/media_type/operation to ArtifactBroker and the product event contains no name.

evidence.summary: Worker captures the requested name.
Backend ignores item['name'] when storing and emitting the reference.
A failed-cell artifact was readable by digest but no logical filename was recoverable.

defects.violated_invariant: A user-declared artifact identity must survive as a normalized result binding without becoming a host path.
defects.repair_boundary: Keep ArtifactReference content-addressed; add versioned ArtifactBinding with logical_name, role and producer provenance.

defects.title: Artifact publication precedes cell terminal settlement
defects.native_trigger: Stage an artifact and then raise an exception in the same IPython cell.
defects.observed_result: The cell returns failed, but the artifact event/reference is already durable and readable.

evidence.summary: status=failed, event kinds included artifact then exception, artifact_readback='PARTIAL'.
Artifact sink writes occur while events are decoded, before final status/result construction.

defects.violated_invariant: Deliverable publication must be bound to a certain cell commit; failed/suspended/cancelled work cannot silently publish final artifacts.
defects.repair_boundary: Add staged artifact state, a CellCommitManifest, idempotent promotion/reconciliation, and an explicit separate diagnostic-artifact policy.

defects.title: Portable RLM has no workspace binding or Python action
defects.native_trigger: Start aar_rlm_execute and expect the RLM to own/use the verified IPython workbench.
defects.observed_result: RlmJobSpec has no workspace reference and RlmAction supports only evidence.query/model.request.

evidence.summary: v1 job/action/result contract has no workbench semantics.
Strategies emit fixed one/two-step actions and _execute_action handles only evidence/model.
Original contract anticipated workspace reference and model-written Python with typed brokers.

defects.violated_invariant: The completed product journey is one RLM-native workbench operation, not two manually coordinated products.
defects.repair_boundary: Add aar_rlm_workbench_execute and v2 workbench models/coordinator while keeping v1 byte-compatible.

defects.title: Typed broker facade exists but is unreachable from model-written Python
defects.native_trigger: Run model-written Python and attempt bounded model, subagent, evidence, artifact or effect-intent methods through the documented architecture.
defects.observed_result: IPython injects only aar_artifact, aar_display and aar_progress; RLM cannot execute subagent/artifact/effect actions.

evidence.summary: No typed aar.model/agents/evidence/effects facade or broker-frame path exists.
BoundBrokerFacade already implements model/subagent/effect/artifact/evidence methods.

defects.violated_invariant: Python is the orchestration language and typed brokers are the authority boundary; both must be reachable in the same operation.
defects.repair_boundary: Add framed worker/supervisor broker IPC, generated capability-bound facade, durable suspension and receipt replay.

defects.title: Hermes full profile does not provide the promised modern host-owned RLM route
defects.native_trigger: Install the generated Hermes profile and call aar_capabilities before real RLM work.
defects.observed_result: mcp.json launches aar-mcp with empty args and live model_broker.configured=false, while profile prose says the profile provides host-owned RLM model calls. The only fixed Sampling route is deprecated compatibility-only; modern caller-delegated RLM is a separate public server.

evidence.summary: package 0.4.0a6, tool surface v7, 30 tools, model_broker.configured=false.
Empty aar-mcp arguments.
Claims ordinary operations and host-owned RLM calls.

defects.violated_invariant: A generated profile must not advertise a real host-owned call path that its live capabilities do not configure.
defects.repair_boundary: Expose generic caller-work claim/commit on the full workbench path or inject a qualified model registry; generate profile prose/capabilities from that exact configuration.

defects.title: RLM lease heartbeat is step-boundary, not independent
defects.native_trigger: Run a service-managed model call longer than the fixed 30-second dispatcher attempt lease.
defects.observed_result: A 35-second bounded model call crosses lease expiry; the attempt becomes indeterminate/failed even though ordinary work is still running.

evidence.summary: 35,000 ms work vs 30,000 ms lease reproduced lease_expired.
heartbeat callback executes only before/after actions.
Lease is fixed at 30 seconds and handler executes synchronously.

defects.violated_invariant: Normal bounded work must not lose ownership merely because the broker call blocks its own step loop.
defects.repair_boundary: Use an independent lease keeper for active service-managed work and no active lease during caller-delegated waiting.

defects.title: Late model-journal writer can overwrite quarantine/terminal settlement
defects.native_trigger: Reconcile an uncertain model call into quarantine while the original physical invocation finishes late.
defects.observed_result: The late writer can replace receipt_lookup_unavailable_quarantined with provider_call_indeterminate.

evidence.summary: Current v0.4.0a6 reproduced non-monotonic late-writer terminalization.
Settlement updates lack a terminal-state/revision compare-and-set guard across racing paths.

defects.violated_invariant: Quarantine and terminal authority are monotonic; later arrival is not stronger evidence.
defects.repair_boundary: Add revision/state guarded CAS transitions and return existing authoritative settlement to stale writers.

defects.title: Attempt fence does not bind all inner RLM/broker writes
defects.native_trigger: A stale attempt returns from a long broker call after lease loss and writes a broker receipt or RLM step before its next outer heartbeat check.
defects.observed_result: Outer terminal transition is fenced, but BrokerContext v1/RlmStore writes do not carry the current attempt/lease identity.

evidence.summary: Broker context/step persistence bind parent operation and step keys, not the current AttemptFence.
Lease-loss and model-journal late-writer probes demonstrate the prerequisite race family; an exact stale-inner-write falsifier is still required.

defects.violated_invariant: After ownership loss, a stale attempt cannot mutate any inner durable truth, not merely the outer operation row.
defects.repair_boundary: Add BrokerContext v2 execution scope and fence every RLM step, journal, artifact, subagent, workspace and result mutation.

defects.title: In-flight RLM cancellation is only observed at step boundaries
defects.native_trigger: Cancel while a model/subagent call or replayable cell is blocked.
defects.observed_result: RlmEngine checks cancellation between actions; current broker protocols do not expose a complete caller-ticket cancellation/unknown-outcome state to the workbench.

evidence.summary: Cancellation checks surround, but do not preempt, action execution.

defects.violated_invariant: Cancellation is durable intent and must invalidate unspent work while preserving unknown physical outcomes.
defects.repair_boundary: Add caller-ticket cancellation, worker interrupt/termination, broker cancel/reconcile, and explicit claimed-outcome-unknown semantics.

defects.title: RLM result cannot return complete workbench outcome
defects.native_trigger: Complete an RLM job that produced named artifacts, child work, workspace state and a structured output.
defects.observed_result: RlmResult v1 contains answer, steps, usage and optional failure only; it has no artifact bindings, workspace/checkpoint disposition, child lineage, output schema, or certainty tier.

evidence.summary: Current result is too narrow for the documented full journey.

defects.violated_invariant: The host must receive one bounded result that accounts for every deliverable and subordinate execution without becoming final delivery.
defects.repair_boundary: Add aar.rlm-workbench-result.v1 and preserve RlmResult v1 compatibility.

defects.title: Worker IPC cannot service typed broker calls during a cell
defects.native_trigger: Model-written Python calls aar.model.request() or aar.agents.run() and waits for a typed result.
defects.observed_result: Current protocol is one supervisor request followed by one terminal worker response; no broker request/receipt frames exist.

evidence.summary: No bidirectional mid-execution broker frame state machine exists.

defects.violated_invariant: The workbench cannot be the native RLM environment unless Python can cross typed broker boundaries without credentials or raw host effects.
defects.repair_boundary: Version framed IPC, route broker intents in the supervisor, and implement controlled suspension/replay.

defects.title: Full local and modern caller-delegated RLM surfaces are fragmented
defects.native_trigger: Use current recommended caller-delegated model ownership and persistent IPython in one local RLM operation.
defects.observed_result: Modern caller-delegated RLM is in the public HTTP/OAuth product; programmable IPython is in the full local MCP; states and skills are separate and do not share one operation.

evidence.summary: The split is explicit; the public product intentionally excludes arbitrary Python.

defects.violated_invariant: The full local developer journey needs modern host-owned calls without reverting to deprecated MCP Sampling or manual cross-product state transfer.
defects.repair_boundary: Add generic caller work tickets to the full workbench MCP while leaving the public curated surface unchanged.

defects.title: Reference subagent implementation is not a real recursive-agent product adapter
defects.native_trigger: Model-written Python requests a real retained recursive agent through the installed full MCP.
defects.observed_result: ReferenceHost constructs FakeSubagentBroker, which returns deterministic local completed:{task} results; the generated Hermes profile injects no native/caller-delegated child adapter.

evidence.summary: Reference fake is the installed product construction when no host adapter is injected.
Reference subagent completes synchronously without launching a host child.

defects.violated_invariant: Recursive-agent capability must correspond to an admitted retained host child, not a fake result hidden behind a production profile.
defects.repair_boundary: Inject a real caller-delegated/native SubagentBroker; keep the fake only for tests and explicitly project capability absence otherwise.

defects.title: Public privacy/retention deletion policy remains external
defects.native_trigger: Deploy public RLM/workspace state in a production identity/retention environment.
defects.observed_result: Current public docs keep privacy, retention, deletion, abuse control and production identity as explicit external gates.

evidence.summary: No production deployment claim exists.

defects.violated_invariant: A public production claim requires explicit retention/deletion/identity authority.
defects.repair_boundary: Separate production deployment SDD; do not block the local workbench implementation or smuggle this authority into AAR core.

defects.title: IPython process isolation is not a security sandbox
defects.native_trigger: Treat arbitrary model-written Python as safe production code solely because it runs in a worker process.
defects.observed_result: Capabilities and architecture explicitly deny workspace.security-sandbox; process isolation is containment only.

evidence.summary: The limitation is explicit and therefore not a hidden bug.

defects.violated_invariant: No managed/security claim may be inferred from process isolation.
defects.repair_boundary: Keep the boundary explicit; require a separate verified security profile for managed use.

defects.title: Arbitrary live Python object recovery is unsupported
defects.native_trigger: Expect arbitrary Python stacks, generators, sockets, DataFrames or provider calls to restart in place.
defects.observed_result: Portable checkpoint supports a conservative JSON subset and reports excluded live objects.

evidence.path: ARCHITECTURE.md and programmable workspace checkpoint code
evidence.summary: Unsupported live state is classified, not silently serialized.

defects.violated_invariant: Recovery must continue only from certain portable boundaries.
defects.repair_boundary: Use pre-cell checkpoints, artifact-backed state and replay; park when required live state is not portable.

defects.title: ModelRequest v1 cannot bind the planner's structured response contract
defects.native_trigger: Ask the root planner for an execute_cell/finalize/abstain directive and require strict validation before executing code.
defects.observed_result: ModelRequest v1 carries only prompt text. It has no response-schema version/digest, maximum response bytes, or purpose binding; prompt-only JSON instructions cannot satisfy the workbench directive contract.

evidence.summary: ModelRequest v1 contains prompt only; ModelResponse v1 returns output only.

defects.violated_invariant: No model output becomes executable Python or terminal product truth until it passes the exact admitted response contract.
defects.repair_boundary: Add ModelRequest v2 response-contract binding and validate raw caller/model output inside AAR before directive creation; preserve v1 bytes.

defects.title: Reference fake backends can be projected as product capabilities
defects.native_trigger: Load the generated full profile, inspect capabilities, then invoke model, subagent, or evidence methods without injected production adapters.
defects.observed_result: ReferenceHost constructs FakeModelBroker, FakeSubagentBroker, and FakeEvidenceProvider. Live model availability has a configured=false row, but subagent/evidence lack equivalent product-availability truth and capability descriptors still exist.

evidence.summary: Reference fakes are constructed by default when no host adapter is injected.
Evidence/subagent reference behavior is deterministic conformance behavior, not real host work.
No test requires equivalent configured/backend-kind/reference-only projection for model, subagent, and evidence methods.

defects.violated_invariant: Capability discovery must distinguish a real configured product adapter from reference/conformance behavior before an agent spends work.
defects.repair_boundary: Project per-method configured, backend_kind, evidence_tier, and reference_only metadata; fail full-journey admission when any required adapter is absent.

defects.title: Portable-regex profile admitted superlinear and cross-runtime-divergent patterns
defects.native_trigger: Admit overlapping bounded quantifiers, a trailing dollar anchor, or an ECMAScript-Unicode identity escape in a caller completion schema.
defects.observed_result: The c153 fixed-point candidate admitted all three; independent hostile review reproduced exponential Python matching and Python/ECMAScript divergence.

evidence.summary: REJECT against package sha256:c153a24c4ede761b6e42fc379bb341264cf24a09a8d955e9741578ff551d7573.

defects.violated_invariant: Caller-selected regex must be demonstrably linear and portable across admitted validators.
defects.repair_boundary: Preflight the portable profile before Draft meta-validation; allow at most one bounded quantified atom, forbid trailing dollar and nonportable identity escapes, and retain direct plus integrated negative regressions.
